fields.title: Our First Date
fields.caption: The day everything began. Coffee turned into a 6-hour conversation that felt like minutes. I knew that night that my life had changed forever.

fields.title: Midnight Stargazing
fields.caption: That perfect summer night when we drove out to the middle of nowhere and just watched the stars. Your laugh was my favorite constellation.

fields.title: The Rainy Day We Got Lost
fields.caption: We got completely lost in that small town, but ended up finding the coziest bookstore café. Sometimes wrong turns lead to the right destinations.

fields.title: Surprise Birthday Party
fields.caption: Planning that surprise party gave me more anxiety than anything, but seeing your face made it all worth it. I'd do anything to see you that happy again.

fields.title: Morning Coffee Ritual
fields.caption: Those quiet mornings with coffee, sunlight streaming through the kitchen window, and you telling me about your dreams. These simple moments mean everything.

fields.title: Our First Apartment
fields.caption: Moving in together felt like coming home. Boxes everywhere, but somehow it felt perfect because you were there.

fields.title: That Perfect Sunset
fields.caption: We climbed to the top of that hill just to see the sunset, but really I just wanted to see your face in the golden light. You're more beautiful than any sunset.

fields.title: Dancing in the Kitchen
fields.caption: No music, just us. You said I was a terrible dancer but you laughed anyway. I'll take terrible dancing if it means I get to see you smile like that.

fields.title: The Beach Trip
fields.caption: Getting caught in that rainstorm was the best thing that happened. Nothing else in the world mattered except you and I in that little café, waiting for the storm to pass.

fields.title: Our Secret Message
fields.caption: This is the one that only you can find. Hidden in our universe, waiting to be discovered. This is my promise to you: I will love you through every memory we make and every star we discover together. You are my universe, my everything, my forever.
